
Writing Goal

Generate phone calls and service requests.

Every page should help the visitor:

- Trust the company
- Understand the problem
- Take action

---

Tone of Voice

Professional

Friendly

Local

Confident

Helpful

Not overly salesy

Not corporate sounding

---

Writing Rules

Use short paragraphs.

Use clear language.

Avoid fluff.

Avoid keyword stuffing.

Avoid exaggerated claims.

Do not use:

- Best in Arizona
- Number One Company
- Guaranteed Cheapest

Unless verified.

---

SEO Rules

Include primary keyword in:

- Title
- Meta Description
- H1
- First paragraph

Include related keywords naturally.

Use semantic headings.

Example:

H1

Refrigerator Repair in Phoenix

H2

Common Refrigerator Problems

H2

Brands We Service

H2

Why Choose AZ Freeze Appliance Repair

H2

Frequently Asked Questions

---

Service Page Formula

1. Introduction
2. Common Problems
3. Brands Serviced
4. Repair Process
5. Why Choose Us
6. FAQ
7. CTA

---

Brand Page Formula

1. Brand Introduction
2. Common Issues
3. Models Serviced
4. Repair Process
5. FAQ
6. CTA

---

City Page Formula

1. Service Overview
2. Areas Served
3. Appliance Types
4. Why Local Customers Choose Us
5. FAQ
6. CTA

---

Call To Action Examples

Call Now

Schedule Service

Book Appliance Repair

Request Same-Day Service

Speak With A Technician

Get Your Appliance Fixed Today

---

Trust Building Elements

Same Day Service

Experienced Technician

Transparent Pricing

Local Arizona Business

Fast Response Time

Professional Service

---

FAQ Guidelines

Create FAQs relevant to:

- appliance type
- brand
- city

Use FAQ schema.

Minimum:
5 questions

Recommended:
10 questions

---

Internal Linking

Every page should contain:

3-10 internal links

Link to:

- service pages
- city pages
- brand pages

---

Local SEO

Mention:

Phoenix

Tempe

Mesa

Chandler

Gilbert

Scottsdale

Naturally within content.

Avoid repetitive city lists.

---

Conversion Rules

Phone number visible above the fold.

CTA button every 1-2 sections.

Footer CTA.

Mobile click-to-call button.

---

Content Quality

Every page must contain:

Minimum 800 words.

Target:
1200-1800 words.

All content must be unique.

No duplicate city pages.

No duplicate brand pages.
